stepVerbs.expect: text must be visible within 20 s, else the take stops
stepVerbs.click: move the cursor to the element (role + name, or text), outline it, click
stepVerbs.clickIfPresent: click only when the element exists (optional wizard steps)
stepVerbs.hover: move the cursor to the element and hold
stepVerbs.type: type text (into a placeholder or the focused element)
stepVerbs.waitTurn: wait until the agent turn ends (no Stop button); the edit speed-ramps this span
stepVerbs.ensureOption: open a combobox and pick an option only when it does not already show it
stepVerbs.offCamera: run scripts/<script> against the demo HOME between frames; nothing changes on screen. A click step can carry it as offCameraBeforeClick

shots.vo: Codex in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.

card.title: Codex in SpecWithCode
card.subtitle: Plan, build and review one task. The plan stays in your repo.

shots.vo: In your repo, run specweave init. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.

showLines: ✓ 11 skills installed as sw-* in .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/
steps.elide: dim … row between and after the two lines

shots.vo: Open SpecWithCode. In setup, keep this computer and click Continue. On the Codex card, click Continue with ChatGPT, or run codex login, then Use existing CLI. The card says Ready to code.
shots.stepChip: Setup → Continue → Codex: Use existing CLI → Ready to code

steps.note: the computer is named by a scutil shim in the demo PATH
the demo HOME starts signed out

steps.name: Continue with ChatGPT
steps.note: never clicked on camera: it opens the OpenAI sign-in page

steps.name: Use existing CLI
steps.note: codex-auth.sh runs right before the click and stands in for `codex login` in a terminal: it copies this Mac's Codex login into the demo HOME. Run any earlier and the card turns Ready on its own, showing the (masked) account row
the card reads "Ready to code." and "Ready"; no account email is shown

shots.vo: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Codex in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

steps.name: Add project
steps.note: the + next to Projects
"New project" and "Personal assistant" rows sit above it
adding the folder opens a new chat; no separate New chat click
the model picker is labelled with the current model (GPT-6.1-Sol, Codex's default, once Codex is ready)
every model in the list is tagged Codex

steps.name: Runtime mode
steps.note: defaults to Supervised

shots.vo: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Codex writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Increment → describe the change → Enter

steps.name: Message
steps.note: placeholder "Ask for changes, send follow-ups, or attach images" on a new chat
the menu lists the 11 skills title-cased: Sw Auto … Sw Team, each tagged Repo Skill

steps.text: Personal greeting: greet(name) returns "Hello, <name>!" and greet() still returns "Hello, world!". Use Ada in examples. Plan only, no code yet.

steps.note: send button aria-label "Submit message"
speed-ramped in the edit, with the Sped up chip
Codex's reply starts "Created spec.md", then the acceptance criteria and the tasks
hold on the reply: Created spec.md, the acceptance criteria, the tasks with npm test

shots.vo: Then send sw-do. Codex claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Do → claim → edit → test → done

steps.text: Do T-01, then stop. I will close the increment myself.

steps.note: expands the turn's steps
hold on the expanded steps: git add and commit, specweave task done T-01 0001 --run "npm test", git merge --ff-only inc/0001-codex, and the reply "T-01 is committed and marked done."

shots.vo: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

steps.note: on the last turn's "8 changed files" card (increment files, src, test, README.md)
the done line: "by":"codex@demo" with its evidence

shots.vo: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
